label: Ash'arite occasionalist rival: things… alternative to Nothing is moved except insofar as it is…
note: Class: not yet attackable. The Ash'arite view escapes the Megarian refutation: it grants change but reads it as God's re-creation of each state, so it denies that change is a being moved in the sense of DEF-MOTION-AS-REDUCTION (DISAMB-MOTION). Missing: a witness (al-Ghazali, Tahafut, discussion 17; candidate GHAZALI-TAHAFUT-17) and an argument that successive re-creation is not a coherent account of change.
